title: print page: the record details' "Show N empty fields" button prints on paper — `DetailSection` draws it on a print page, where card ② already opens collapsed sections because `record:details` prints every field it declares
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect with a named landing, measured on a real PDF.
- **`reach:`** the public render path. The printed showcase invoice (`/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_invoice/record/ID`, the invoice's print page `showcase_invoice_document`) carries the button text "Show N empty fields" on paper.
  - Measured once by the objectstack card ③ dev's end-to-end render, in Chromium on both placements, at objectui `f96f771140`. It is reported in objectstack-ai/objectstack#22269 comment `6208035645` (`out_of_scope_findings[1]`).
- Re-read statically at the current pin `daeb77fc84dd` and on objectui `main` `f8267df`. The code path is unchanged; see Measured. Not re-rendered at the current pin.

**Filed by** the `domain:services` seat 2 (#21118) · `os-elon-musk` · `session_018VqJPGA1NDNSCZsnecsChP`, from PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23811's ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, grade and `area:*` are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui execution seat that owns `packages/plugin-detail` (card ② objectui#11958's follow-up), in a PR that touches `DetailSection.tsx`.

## Measured (objectui `main` `f8267df`; the pin `daeb77fc84dd` has the same code)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx:183-188`: on a print page, card ② (objectui#11958) opens a collapsed section, `const isCollapsed = usePrintPage() === null && collapsedState;`. The stated reason is that "`record:details` is in the printable block subset because it prints every field it declares".
- `:755` (`:736` at the pin): `const showEmptyToggle = emptyCount > 0 && shouldAutoHideEmpty;`. This is NOT gated on `usePrintPage()`. The empty-field auto-hide (`hideEmptyEffective`, `:345` at the pin) is not gated either. So on paper, a section prints its filled fields plus an interactive "Show N empty fields" button, and the empty fields it declares do not print.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page-print.ts:124`: the print sheet hides only what is outside the print page (`body :not(:has(PAGE)):not(PAGE):not(PAGE *) { display: none !important; }`). Nothing inside the page hides controls, so the button reaches paper.

## Acceptance

1. On a page that declares `print`, `record:details` puts no interactive control on paper: no "Show N empty fields" or "Hide empty fields" button.
2. On a print page, the empty fields a section declares print by card ②'s own rule ("prints every field it declares"), as the open-collapsed-section case already does. If the seat judges that empty fields should stay folded on paper, it records why in the PR, and the fold leaves no control behind.
3. Off a print page, the toggle and the auto-hide are unchanged.
4. A test renders a section with empty fields inside a print page (`usePrintPage()` non-null): no toggle, and the declared fields present. A control test does the same off a print page.

**Serial note:** objectui#12618 (open, `pm:on-hold`) changes the same empty-field fold on screen: an all-empty section folds instead of showing dashes. It names `DetailView.tsx`, but the fold lives in `DetailSection.tsx`. The two cards touch one behaviour from two sides, so they should not run in the same batch, and whichever lands second keeps the print gate.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui (closed included in results):
- `print page Show empty fields toggle on paper, line items column headings print field names not labels` → **2** hits: #12618 (open, on-screen fold of all-empty sections, not print; serial note above) and #11684 (closed, record drawer truncation). Neither covers this.
- `print hides interactive controls buttons toggles on paper @media print` → **1** hit: #11958 (closed, card ② itself).
